G4012.strongs: properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period)
G4012.kjv: (there-)about, above, against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, X how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-)state, (as) touching, (where-)by (in), with
senses: prep. with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, Pr., 105f.), with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides).

Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], [[r:MRK.1.44|Mrk 1:44]], [[r:LUK.4.38|Luk 4:38]], [[r:JHN.16.26|Jhn 16:26]], [[r:ACT.28.21|Act 28:21]], al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, the things concerning one, one's state or case: [[r:MRK.5.27|Mrk 5:27]], [[r:ACT.1.3|Act 1:3 28:15]], [[r:EPH.6.22|Eph 6:22]], al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, [[r:1CO.7.1|1Co 7:1]], al.; in the sense on account of ([[r:MAT.26.28|Mat 26:28]], [[r:1CO.1.13|1Co 1:13]], al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105).

of place, about, around: [[r:MAT.3.4|Mat 3:4]], [[r:MRK.1.6|Mrk 1:6]], [[r:LUK.13.8|Luk 13:8]], [[r:ACT.22.6|Act 22:6]], al.; οἱ περί, with accusative of person(s), of one's associates, friends, etc., [[r:MRK.4.10|Mrk 4:10]], [[r:LUK.22.49|Luk 22:49]], [[r:JHN.11.19|Jhn 11:19]], [[r:ACT.13.13|Act 13:13]]; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, [[r:ACT.19.25|Act 19:25]]; metaphorically, about, as to, concerning: [[r:1TI.1.19|1Ti 1:19 6:4]] [[r:2TI.2.18|2Ti 2:18 3:8]], [[r:TIT.2.7|Tit 2:7]]; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, [[r:PHP.2.23|Php 2:23]]; αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, [[r:MRK.4.19|Mrk 4:19.]]
Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: [[r:MAT.20.3|Mat 20:3, 5 6, 9 27:46]], [[r:MRK.6.48|Mrk 6:48]], [[r:ACT.10.3|Act 10:3, 9 22:6]].
In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω). (AS)

G4098.root: probably akin to [[w:G4072]] through the idea of alighting
senses: of descent, to fall, fall down or from: before ἐπί, with accusative loc., [[r:MAT.10.29|Mat 10:29]], al.; εἰς, [[r:MAT.15.14|Mat 15:14]], al.; ἐς μέσῳ, with genitive, [[r:LUK.8.7|Luk 8:7]]; παρὰ τ. ὁδόν, [[r:MAT.13.4|Mat 13:4]], [[r:MRK.4.4|Mrk 4:4]], [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5]]; before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.15.27|Mat 15:27]], al.; ἐκ, [[r:MRK.13.25|Mrk 13:25]], [[r:LUK.10.18|Luk 10:18]], [[r:REV.8.10|Rev 8:10 9:1]]. Metaphorical: ὁ ἥλιος, before ἐπί, [[r:REV.7.16|Rev 7:16]]; ἀχλὺς κ. σκότος, [[r:ACT.13.11|Act 13:11]]; ὁ κλῆρος, [[r:ACT.1.26|Act 1:26]]; ὑπὸ κρίσιν, [[r:JAS.5.12|Jas 5:12.]]

of persons, to fall prostrate, prostrate oneself: χαμαί [[r:JHN.18.6|Jhn 18:6]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:MAT.17.6|Mat 17:6]], [[r:ACT.9.4|Act 9:4]]; id. with genitive, [[r:MRK.9.20|Mrk 9:20]]; πρὸς τ. πόδας, [[r:ACT.5.10|Act 5:10]], [[r:REV.1.17|Rev 1:17]]; πεσὼν ἐξέψυξε, [[r:ACT.5.5|Act 5:5]]; of supplication, homage or worship: πρὸς (παρὰ, ἐπὶ) τ. πὸδας, [[r:MRK.5.22|Mrk 5:22]], [[r:LUK.8.41|Luk 8:41]], [[r:ACT.10.25|Act 10:25]], al.; π. καὶ προσκυνεῖν, [[r:REV.5.14|Rev 5:14 19:4]]; ptcp. with προσκυνεῖν, [[r:MAT.2.11|Mat 2:11]], al.; ἐνώπιον, [[r:REV.4.10|Rev 4:10 5:8]]; ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, [[r:MAT.26.39|Mat 26:39]], al.;

of things, to fall, fall down: [[r:MAT.21.44|Mat 21:44]], [[r:LUK.23.30|Luk 23:30]]; of falling to ruin and destruction, [[r:MAT.7.25|Mat 7:25]], [[r:ACT.15.16|Act 15:16]], [[r:HEB.11.30|Heb 11:30]]; ἔπεσε (timeless aorist; M, Pr.,134), [[r:REV.18.2|Rev 18:2.]] Metaphorical: [[r:ROM.11.11|Rom 11:11]]; πόθεν πέπτωκας, [[r:REV.2.5|Rev 2:5]]; opposite to ἑστόναι, [[r:1CO.10.12|1Co 10:12]]; to στήκειν, [[r:ROM.14.4|Rom 14:4]]; of virtues, [[r:1CO.13.8|1Co 13:8]]; of precepts, [[r:LUK.16.17|Luk 16:17.]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, περι-, προσ-, συν-πίπτω.) συν-πίπτω (Rec. συμπ-), to fall together, fall in, etc.: of a house (cf. MM, xxiv), [[r:LUK.6.49|Luk 6:49.]]† (AS)

G4066.strongs: around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with implied vicinity)
G4066.kjv: country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about
senses: περί-χωρος, -ον round about, neighbouring (Dem., Plut., al.). In LXX and NT, as subst., ἡ π. (sc. γῆ), the region round about: [[r:MAT.14.35|Mat 14:35]], [[r:MRK.1.28|Mrk 1:28]], [[r:LUK.4.14|Luk 4:14, 37 7:17 8:37]], [[r:ACT.14.6|Act 14:6]]; ἡ π. τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, [[r:LUK.3.3|Luk 3:3]]; by meton. for the people of the same region, [[r:MAT.3.5|Mat 3:5.]]† (AS)

G4008.root: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of πείρω (to "pierce")
G4008.strongs: through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across
senses: πέραν adv., on the other side, across (usually with the idea of water lying between);

as in the older poets, as prep. with genitive: τ. θαλάσσης, [[r:JHN.6.1|Jhn 6:1, 17 6:22, 25]]; τ. Ἰορδάνου, [[r:MAT.4.15|Mat 4:15]] (LXX), [[r:MAT.4.25|Mat 4:25 19:1]], [[r:MRK.3.8|Mrk 3:8 10:1]], [[r:JHN.1.28|Jhn 1:28 3:26 10:40]]; τ. χειμάρρου τ. Κέδρων, [[r:JHN.18.1|Jhn 18:1]];
τὸ π., the region beyond, the other side: [[r:MAT.8.18|Mat 8:18, 28 14:22 16:5]], [[r:MRK.4.35|Mrk 4:35 5:21 6:45 8:13]]; τ. θαλάσσης, [[r:MRK.5.1|Mrk 5:1]]; τ. λίμνης, [[r:LUK.8.22|Luk 8:22.]]† (AS)

G4043.strongs: to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary)
senses: περι-πατέω, -ῶ to walk: absol., [[r:MAT.9.5|Mat 9:5]], [[r:MRK.5.42|Mrk 5:42]], [[r:LUK.5.23|Luk 5:23]], [[r:JHN.1.36|Jhn 1:36]]; with pred., γυμνός, [[r:REV.16.15|Rev 16:15]]; ἐπάνω [[r:LUK.11.44|Luk 11:44]]; διά, with genitive, [[r:REV.21.24|Rev 21:24]]; ἐν, [[r:MRK.11.27|Mrk 11:27 12:38]], [[r:JHN.7.1|Jhn 7:1 11:54]], [[r:REV.2.1|Rev 2:1]], al.; ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ, figuratively, [[r:JHN.8.12|Jhn 8:12 12:35]], [[r:1JN.1.6|1Jn 1:6-7]] [[r:JHN.2.11|Jn 2:11]]; ἐπί, with genitive, [[r:MAT.14.26|Mat 14:26]]; id. with dative, [[r:MAT.14.25|Mat 14:25, 29]]; μετά, [[r:JHN.6.66|Jhn 6:66]], [[r:REV.3.4|Rev 3:4]]; παρά, with accusative, [[r:MAT.4.18|Mat 4:18.]] Metaphorical, of living, passing one's life, conducting oneself (like ἀναστρέφομαι in Xen., Plut., LXX, π.; M, [[r:PRO.11.1|Pro 11:1-31]]; Deiss., BS, 194): ἀκριβῶς, [[r:EPH.5.15|Eph 5:15]]; ἀτάκτως, [[r:2TH.3.6|2Th 3:6 3:11]]; εὐσχημόνως, [[r:REV.13.13|Rev 13:13]], [[r:1TH.4.12|1Th 4:12]]; ἀξίως, with genitive, [[r:EPH.4.1|Eph 4:1]], [[r:COL.1.10|Col 1:10]], [[r:1TH.2.12|1Th 2:12]]; καθώς (ὥς), [[r:EPH.4.17|Eph 4:17 5:8, 15]], [[r:PHP.3.17|Php 3:17]], [[r:1TH.4.1|1Th 4:1]]; οὕτως ὥς, [[r:1CO.7.17|1Co 7:17]]; before nom. qual., [[r:PHP.3.18|Php 3:18]]; with dative, [[r:ACT.21.21|Act 21:21]], [[r:ROM.13.13|Rom 13:13]], [[r:2CO.12.18|2Co 12:18]], [[r:GAL.5.16|Gal 5:16]]; before ἐν, [[r:ROM.6.4|Rom 6:4]], [[r:2CO.4.2|2Co 4:2 5:7 10:3]], [[r:EPH.2.2|Eph 2:2, 10 4:17 5:2]], [[r:COL.3.7|Col 3:7 4:5]], [[r:HEB.13.9|Heb 13:9]], 2Jn 4 Jn 6, al.; ἐν Χριστῷ, [[r:COL.2.6|Col 2:6]]; κατά, with accusative, [[r:MRK.7.5|Mrk 7:5]], [[r:ROM.8.4|Rom 8:4 14:15]], [[r:1CO.3.3|1Co 3:3]], [[r:2CO.10.2|2Co 10:2]], 2Jn 6 (cf. ἐν-περιπατέω). (AS)

G4074.forms: Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς)
G4074.strongs: a (piece of) rock (larger than); as a name, Petrus, an apostle

G4013.strongs: to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around
senses: to lead about or around: with accusative of person(s), [[r:1CO.9.5|1Co 9:5.]]

Intrans., to go about: [[r:ACT.13.11|Act 13:11]]; before ἐν, [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23]]; with accusative loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., see Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), [[r:MAT.9.35|Mat 9:35 23:15]], [[r:MRK.6.6|Mrk 6:6]].† (AS)

G4052.strongs: to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel
G4052.kjv: (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above)
senses: of things, to be over and above the number (Hes.), hence,
to abound in, have in abundance: [[r:1CO.14.12|1Co 14:12 15:58]], [[r:PHP.4.12|Php 4:12, 18]]; with genitive, [[r:LUK.15.17|Luk 15:17]] T;

to be superior or better, to excel: absol., [[r:1CO.3.9|1Co 3:9 8:8]]; with dative ref., [[r:2CO.3.9|2Co 3:9]]; before ἐν, [[r:ROM.15.13|Rom 15:13]], [[r:1CO.15.58|1Co 15:58]], [[r:2CO.3.9|2Co 3:9 8:7]], [[r:COL.2.7|Col 2:7]]; μᾶλλον, [[r:1TH.4.1|1Th 4:1 4:10]]; μ καὶ μ., [[r:PHP.1.9|Php 1:9]]; πλεῖον, [[r:MAT.5.20|Mat 5:20.]]
to make to abound: with accusative before εἰς, [[r:2CO.4.15|2Co 4:15 9:8]], [[r:EPH.1.8|Eph 1:8]]; pass., [[r:MAT.13.12|Mat 13:12 25:29]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:LUK.15.17|Luk 15:17]], WH;
to make to excel: with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), [[r:1TH.3.12|1Th 3:12]] (cf. ὑπερ-περισσεύω).† SYN.: πλεονάζω (AS)

G4053.strongs: superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence
G4053.kjv: exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly)
senses: more than sufficient, over and above, abundant: [[r:JHN.10.10|Jhn 10:10]], [[r:2CO.9.1|2Co 9:1]]; with genitive (a popular substitute for πλειών, Bl., § 11, 3.4), [[r:MAT.5.37|Mat 5:37]]; id. with ellips. genitive, [[r:MAT.5.47|Mat 5:47]] (EV, more than others; but see infr.); εκ περισσοῦ, [[r:MRK.6.51|Mrk 6:51]], Rec., T. (on ὑπὲρ ὲκ π., see: ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ). Compar. neut., -ότερον: [[r:LUK.12.4|Luk 12:4, 48]]; with genitive, [[r:MRK.12.33|Mrk 12:33]]; adverbially (cf. περισσῶς), more abund­antly, [[r:2CO.10.8|2Co 10:8]], [[r:HEB.6.17|Heb 6:17 7:15]]; with genitive, π. πάντων, [[r:1CO.15.10|1Co 15:10]]; pleonast., μᾶλλον π., [[r:MRK.7.36|Mrk 7:36.]]

out of the common, pre-eminent, superior: [[r:MAT.5.47|Mat 5:47]] (Thayer, see word, but see supr.); τὸ π., as subst., [[r:ROM.3.1|Rom 3:1]]; compar., -ότερος, with genitive, [[r:MAT.11.9|Mat 11:9]], [[r:LUK.7.26|Luk 7:26]]; with subst., [[r:MRK.12.40|Mrk 12:40]], [[r:LUK.20.47|Luk 20:47]], [[r:1CO.12.23|1Co 12:23-24]], [[r:2CO.2.7|2Co 2:7]].† (AS)

G4095.root: a prolonged form of πίω; which (together with another form) πόω; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses
senses: πίνω to drink: absol., [[r:LUK.2.19|Luk 2:19]], [[r:JHN.4.7|Jhn 4:7]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26, 31]] [[r:MRK.14.25|Mrk 14:25]], al.; of habitual use, [[r:LUK.1.15|Luk 1:15]], [[r:ROM.14.21|Rom 14:21]], al.; by meton., τὸ ποτήριον, [[r:1CO.10.21|1Co 10:21]], al.; of the earth absorbing rain (Hdt., al.), [[r:HEB.6.7|Heb 6:7]]; spiritually, of the blood of Christ, [[r:JHN.6.53|Jhn 6:53-54, 56]]; before ἐκ (of the vessel), [[r:MAT.26.27|Mat 26:27]], al.; id. (of the drink; Bl., § 36, 1), [[r:MAT.26.29|Mat 26:29]], [[r:JHN.4.13|Jhn 4:13-14]] [[r:REV.14.10|Rev 14:10]], al.; ἀπό, [[r:LUK.22.18|Luk 22:18]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-πίνω; on the form πίεσαι, [[r:LUK.17.8|Luk 17:8]], see Bl., § 21, 8, and on the contr. aor. πεῖν, M, Pr., 44 f., Thackeray, Gr., 63 f.) (AS)

(πέτομαι), in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., a winged fowl, a bird: pl., [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26 8:20 13:4, 32]], [[r:MRK.4.4|Mrk 4:4, 32]], [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5 9:58 12:24 13:19]], [[r:ACT.10.12|Act 10:12 11:6]], [[r:ROM.1.23|Rom 1:23]], [[r:JAS.3.7|Jas 3:7]].† (AS)

G4083.forms: πῆχυς, -εως genitive pl., -ῶν (for Att.. -εων, see WH, App., 157; Thackeray, Gr., 151; Deiss., BS, 153)
G4083.strongs: the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit
senses: As a measure of length, a cubit: [[r:MAT.6.27|Mat 6:27]], [[r:LUK.12.25|Luk 12:25]], [[r:JHN.21.8|Jhn 21:8]], [[r:REV.21.17|Rev 21:17]].† (AS)

G4016.strongs: to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade or with clothing)
G4016.kjv: array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on
senses: περι-βάλλω to throw around or over, put on or over;
of siege or defen­sive works: χάρακά σοι, [[r:LUK.19.43|Luk 19:43]] (WH, mg.; παρεμβ-, WH, txt.);

of clothing, to put on, wrap about, clothe with: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.23.11|Luk 23:11]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.25.36|Mat 25:36, 38 25:43]]; with dupl. accusative (not cl.; Bl., § 34, 4), [[r:JHN.19.2|Jhn 19:2]]; pf. pass., to have wrapped round one: with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), [[r:MRK.14.51|Mrk 14:51 16:5]], [[r:REV.7.9|Rev 7:9, 13 10:1 11:3 12:1 17:4 18:16 19:13]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:REV.4.4|Rev 4:4]] (WH, txt.; before ἐν, WH, mg.); fut., before ἐν (of. [[r:DEU.22.12|Deu 22:12]], [[r:PSA.45.9|Psa 45:9, 13]]), [[r:REV.3.5|Rev 3:5]]. Mid., to clothe oneself, wrap round or put on oneself: absol., [[r:MAT.6.29|Mat 6:29]], [[r:LUK.12.27|Luk 12:27]], [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.6.31|Mat 6:31]], [[r:ACT.12.8|Act 12:8]], [[r:REV.19.8|Rev 19:8]].† (AS)

a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder : [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24-25 27:51, 60]] [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46]], [[r:LUK.6.48|Luk 6:48 8:6, 13]]; of a hollow rock, a cave, [[r:REV.6.15|Rev 6:15-16]] (of. [[r:ISA.2.10|Isa 2:10]], al.). Metaphorical, [[r:MAT.16.18|Mat 16:18]] (on the meaning, see Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also ICC, in l), [[r:1CO.10.4|1Co 10:4]]; = πέτρος, [[r:ROM.9.33|Rom 9:33]], [[r:1PE.2.8|1Pe 2:8]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G4082.strongs: a wallet or leather pouch for food
senses: πἡρα, -ας, ἡ a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., a wallet (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, see LAE, 108 ff.): [[r:MAT.10.10|Mat 10:10]], [[r:MRK.6.8|Mrk 6:8]], [[r:LUK.9.3|Luk 9:3 10:4 22:35-36]].† (AS)

G4051.kjv: abundance, that was left, over and above
senses: (περισσεύω) that which is over and above, superfluity, abundance: opposite to ὑστέρημα (which see), [[r:2CO.8.13|2Co 8:13-14]]; pl., [[r:MRK.8.8|Mrk 8:8]]; metaphorically, π. τ. καρδίας, [[r:MAT.12.34|Mat 12:34]], [[r:LUK.6.45|Luk 6:45]] (cf. Ec, l.with; Plut., al.).† (AS)
of space: chiefly in pl., τὰ π. τ. γῆς, [[r:MAT.12.42|Mat 12:42]], [[r:LUK.11.31|Luk 11:31]]; τ. οἰκουμένης, [[r:ROM.10.18|Rom 10:18]] (LXX);
(opposite to ἀρχή) the end: with genitive, ἀντιλογίας, [[r:HEB.6.10|Heb 6:10.]]† (AS)
(πέτρα, εἶδος), rock-like, rocky, stony: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, [[r:MAT.13.5|Mat 13:5, 20]], [[r:MRK.4.5|Mrk 4:5, 16]].† (AS)

G4097.strongs: from the base of); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively)
senses: πιπράσκω to sell: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.13.46|Mat 13:46]] (on this pf., see Bl., § 59, 5), [[r:ACT.2.45|Act 2:45 4:34 5:4]]; with genitive (of price), [[r:MAT.26.9|Mat 26:9]], [[r:MRK.14.5|Mrk 14:5]], [[r:JHN.12.5|Jhn 12:5]]; with accusative of person(s) (of slavery), [[r:MAT.18.25|Mat 18:25]]; hence metaphorically, [[r:ROM.7.14|Rom 7:14]] (cf. 4Ki.17:17, [[r:1MA.1.15|1Ma 1:15]], al.).† (AS)
prop., a board, plank; hence, of various at wooden articles;

G4060.strongs: to place around; by implication, to present
G4060.kjv: bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about
senses: περι-τίθημι to place or put around: with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33 27:48]], [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1 15:36]], [[r:JHN.19.29|Jhn 19:29]]; of garments, etc., to put on: [[r:MAT.27.28|Mat 27:28]] [[r:MRK.15.17|Mrk 15:17]] ([[r:SIR.6.31|Sir 6:31]]). Metaphorical, like περιβάλλω, to bestow, confer (Thuc., al., [[r:EST.1.20|Est 1:20]]): [[r:1CO.12.23|1Co 12:23]].† (AS)

G4036.strongs: grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad

senses: πικρῶς adv. (πικρός), bitterly: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., [[r:MAT.26.75|Mat 26:75]], [[r:LUK.22.62|Luk 22:62]] (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).† (AS)

G4091.strongs: close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman
senses: Πειλᾶτος (Rec. Πιλάτος, Tr., -ᾶτος, see WH, App., 155), -ου, ὁ, Pontius Pilate: [[r:MAT.27.2|Mat 27:2]], [[r:MRK.15.1|Mrk 15:1]], [[r:LUK.3.1|Luk 3:1]], [[r:JHN.18.29|Jhn 18:29]], [[r:ACT.3.13|Act 3:13]], [[r:1TI.6.13|1Ti 6:13]], al (AS)

G4057.kjv: exceedingly, out of measure, the more

senses: περι-βλέπω to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at): absol., [[r:MRK.9.8|Mrk 9:8 10:23]]; with inf., [[r:MRK.5.32|Mrk 5:32]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.3.5|Mrk 3:5, 34]], [[r:LUK.6.10|Luk 6:10]]; πάντα, [[r:MRK.11.11|Mrk 11:11.]]† (AS)

G4077.root: probably from [[w:G4078]] (through the idea of gushing plumply)
G4077.strongs: a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring)
senses: a spring, fountain : [[r:JAS.3.11|Jas 3:11]], [[r:2PE.2.17|2Pe 2:17]]; τ. δάτων, [[r:REV.8.10|Rev 8:10 14:7 16:4]]; of a well fed by a spring, [[r:JHN.4.6|Jhn 4:6]]; π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, [[r:MRK.5.29|Mrk 5:29]]; metaphorically, [[r:JHN.4.14|Jhn 4:14]], [[r:REV.7.17|Rev 7:17 21:6]].† (AS)
